_doc: Inventario de arte y audio de GuildMaster (docs/ASSETS.md). Una entrada por asset. Estado de arte: falta → greybox → concepto → sprite → animado → final; audio: falta → provisional → generado → final. «para»: hito(s) y entidad o sistema que lo necesita. «origen»: PixelLab id o prompt de fal del asset actual; «origen_previo»: lo que hay en el repo guild y se puede traer. «coste_gen»: generaciones gastadas (detalle en assets/art/MANIFEST.md). Comprobación: python3 tools/arte.py [--falta].

assets.origen: elevenlabs: Instrumental medieval folk music for a 14th-century Central European market town by day. Warm plucked lute and wooden recorder melody, light fiddle, soft frame drum, small acoustic ensemble of three or four players, cheerful but relaxed, about 100 bpm, cozy pastoral life-sim game soundtrack. No orchestra, no choir, no epic cinematic percussion, no vocals. Even energy from start to end: no intro build-up and no final ending, so it loops seamlessly.
